subject.title: [Bug]: One-shot run cleanup leaks codex app-server process (inverted closeAndWait condition) → duplicate app-servers → spurious turn_aborted

question: Should maintainers accept the reporter's 2026.7.1-beta.2 process-count evidence as enough to queue a fix now, or first require a current-main macOS/Codex app-server reproduction?
rationale: Current source confirms the cleanup surface but also shows transport close() now has force-kill behavior, so automation should not pick the exact fix shape without a maintainer proof threshold decision.

options.title: Require current-main repro first
options.body: Ask for or run a macOS/current-main one-shot process-count proof before choosing the cleanup change, preserving the issue as the canonical focused report meanwhile.

options.title: Queue a narrow cleanup fix now
options.body: Treat the beta evidence as sufficient and repair the one-shot retire/closeAndWait invariant with focused tests around active-lease and idle-settling behavior.

recommendation.title: Require current-main repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a macOS/current-main one-shot process-count proof before choosing the cleanup change, preserving the issue as the canonical focused report meanwhile.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged one-shot app-server teardown helper that this report challenges.
